# Alternator Rebuild Procedure

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

_No verified summary yet._

## Tools

- Impact Wrench [t32]
- Strap Wrench [t32]
- 24mm Socket [t32]
- 18mm Socket [t32]
- 10mm Socket [t32]
- 8mm Socket [t32]
- Small Gear Puller [t32]
- Flat Head Screw Driver [t32]
- Hammer (Deadblow preferred) [t32]
- Stiff Wire [t32]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a small piece of stiff wire (like from a coat hanger) to temporarily hold brushes in place during assembly. [t32]
- Polish slip rings with 600 grit wet/dry sandpaper wrapped around them, turning the rotor by hand or on a lathe. [t32]

## Common mistakes

- Damaging the sliprings while removing the rear bearing from the shaft. [t32]
- Letting brushes fall off when sliding the end housing onto the rotor without securing them first. [t32]
